course: ITE 18 · Applications Development and Emerging Technologies

modules.title: JavaScript Foundations
modules.summary: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript: types and operators, DOM rendering, closures, the event loop and async/await.

projects.title: Campus Canteen Calculator
projects.summary: Order totals with student/staff pricing, receipts and input validation. Covers string vs number addition and type conversion.

projects.title: Study Task Dashboard
projects.summary: A task list rendered from data with filters and bulk actions, showing dynamic DOM rendering.

projects.title: CollegeMemory Landing Page
projects.summary: A responsive college memory timeline with bento-style image galleries built with CSS Grid and Flexbox.

projects.title: Class Resource Loader
projects.summary: A simulated request with loading, failure and retry states, plus a trace of the call stack, microtasks and timers.

projects.title: Rock Paper Scissors
projects.summary: A game against the computer; first to 5 points wins.

projects.title: Etch-a-Sketch
projects.summary: A resizable drawing grid with black and rainbow modes that darkens on each pass.

projects.title: Calculator
projects.summary: A calculator that chains operations and works with the mouse or keyboard.

modules.title: Three.js Part 1: The Basics
modules.summary: Scenes, cameras, transforms, animation, geometries, debug UI, textures, materials, 3D text and deploying online.

projects.title: Basic Scene
projects.summary: The four parts every Three.js scene needs: a scene, a mesh, a perspective camera and a WebGL renderer.

projects.title: Local Server (Vite)
projects.summary: The same scene served through Vite, importing Three.js from node_modules and loading static assets.

projects.title: Transform Objects
projects.summary: Position, scale, rotation order, lookAt, AxesHelper and a Group of cubes transformed together.

projects.title: Animations
projects.summary: A frame-rate independent loop with delta time and THREE.Clock, circular motion and a GSAP tween.

projects.title: Cameras
projects.summary: A red cube you can rotate around with the mouse using OrbitControls with damping.

projects.title: Fullscreen and Resizing
projects.summary: The scene fills the window, handles resizing and pixel ratio, and goes fullscreen on double-click.

projects.title: Geometries
projects.summary: Box and sphere geometries, then 50 random triangles built from a BufferGeometry.

projects.title: Debug UI
projects.summary: A control panel to move, hide, recolor and spin the cube.

projects.title: Textures
projects.summary: Images on a cube, ending with a Minecraft-style block.

projects.title: Materials
projects.summary: Every material from the handout, switchable from a menu.

projects.title: 3D Text
projects.summary: "Hello Three.js" in 3D with 100 donuts around it.

projects.title: Go Live
projects.summary: Name and section in 3D, built for production and published online.

modules.title: Three.js Part 2: Lights and Shadows
modules.summary: Every light type, three ways to fake or render shadows, and a full scene built from primitives.

projects.title: Lights
projects.summary: All six light types and their helpers, switchable from the debug panel.

projects.title: Shadows
projects.summary: Real-time, baked and simple shadows, switchable from the debug panel.

projects.title: Haunted House
projects.summary: A house, graves, fog, textures and floating ghost lights with shadows.

modules.title: Three.js Part 3: Particles, Physics and Models
modules.summary: Particle systems, a procedural galaxy, scroll-driven animation, a physics engine and imported glTF models.

projects.title: Particles
projects.summary: Points on a sphere, then thousands of random, colored and animated particles.

projects.title: Galaxy Generator
projects.summary: A procedural spiral galaxy with branches, spin, randomness and inside/outside colors.

projects.title: Scroll Based Animation
projects.summary: A one-page site where the camera follows the scroll, with parallax and toon-shaded objects.

projects.title: Physics
projects.summary: Spheres and boxes that fall, bounce and roll, synced between a physics world and the Three.js scene.

projects.title: Imported Models
projects.summary: glTF, binary, embedded and Draco models, plus an animated fox.
